title: 采访月老的一天

accept.why: by design: in the cold open he is wound into the heap of thread and wades out of it
the rig's rule: an arm or hand drawn under its own head (his beard hangs over his arms when his hands meet in front); the mother's praying hands are drawn in front of her face on purpose
a hanging or clasped hand resting against its own robe, body or pendant (the rig's own cloth; nothing cut on stills)
a held prop touching whoever holds it: the knot in his teeth, the bale hugged to his belly, files and the slip passing his beard, the pen at his chin, the order bag on the rider
thrown, falling or flying things: the spool, the slip, the cloud, the butterflies, the dropped bale and file, the thrown knot
a drawer in its own cabinet
a file or the bale inside its drawer
the mother kneels on her cloud
seated on the steps: the back of his robe presses against the riser behind him (3.6 cm)
at his desk his beard rests on the open book and his hands lie on the pages (up to 4.6 cm; nothing cut on stills 767, 1110, 1136, 1541)
the dropped knot and the old thread lie on the steps; their loops dip into the tread (up to 2.8 cm)
his hem swings against the bale beside him as he starts (4 frames); the falling file passes his robe (1 frame)

_note: Sound (27 Nov 2026, after the owner's audition): scripts/yuelao/sound/build_sound.sh rebuilds the whole mix from the repo and the voice farm's public takes: the 63 lines cut by the committed cut list (voice/takes.json: each line exactly the length the picture was timed to; it stops if the rebuilt timing is out of step with voice/timing_ref.json), the music and effects made in code (make_sound.py), the cues on the picture's own frames (cues.json from make_cues.py + events.ts), the voice ridden under the bed (voice_ride.py), then the kit's build.py. Mono mix about -18.9 LUFS, true peak about -2.3 dBTP. The stems command needs the build's {WORK}/sound from the same run. The gate.accept rules turn the clipping classes accepted in the film's own clipping notes into INFO, each with its reason.
